Description: The armory walls echo with the clang of steel, even when no one swings a blade.
Rows of spears stand ready, their tips dulled more by dust than by battle.
Helmets and shields rest on the tables, each carrying scratches that tell forgotten stories.
The training dummies lean tired against the wall — even straw warriors need a rest.
This chamber once armed whole battalions; now it feels more like a museum of past wars.
If you listen carefully, you might swear the weapons whisper, eager to taste battle again.
